scope: Computational self-consistency screen only; no experimental evidence of binding.

protocol.scope: Computational binder-design workflow demonstration, not evidence of binding. v3 changes exactly one variable across its two arms: binder length. All seeds are pre-registered; every outcome is reported.

binder.pre_registration: All three seeds are declared before any run and every outcome is reported, passing or failing. Additional seeds are not permitted under this protocol version.

optimization.pick: minimum finite evaluated total objective among hard-stage (straight-through one-hot) evaluations only; ties to earliest. The selected iterate is a true one-hot, so the exported sequence is the sequence that was evaluated.

derived_from.single_change: binder length (48 vs 70) and a pre-registered 3-seed set; optimizer, losses, weights, target, redesign, refold and screen unchanged

alignment: C-alpha by residue position; proper Kabsch target-only transform applied to binder.
plddt_source: Per-residue CA B-factors in FastPLMs CIF (0–100); raw pLDDT presence required.
interpretation: Computationally consistent candidate(s), pending experimental validation.
